summary.text: Mark Dorazio is a Republican state representative from Texas who has represented District 122 since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a business owner who runs a construction company in San Antonio.

paragraphs.text: Mark Dorazio was born in Derry, Pennsylvania, and lives in San Antonio, Texas.
His career experience includes owning a construction company, Dorazio Enterprises, Inc., and he has served on the board of The Justice Foundation and as a Republican Party precinct chairman.
Dorazio assumed office in the Texas House on January 10, 2023, succeeding Lyle Larson, a Republican.
In 2023 and 2024 he was assigned to the Defense & Veterans' Affairs Committee and the Homeland Security & Public Safety Committee.
Democrat Shelly Nickels is also on the 2026 general election ballot for District 122.
